SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
S. 2, Special Branch Station,
DRAWER REPORT
Date December 21, 1934.

Subject (in full) Movements of Japanese notables in Shanghai

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by J.B.Kn D..

The undermentioned notables arrived in Shanghai on
December 19 by the training ships "Yagumo" and "Asama" which
berthed at the N.Y... Hon. Kew Mail Wharf, Yangtsze Road:-
Lieutenant Commander Prince Kuni, Chief Gunner of the "Yagumo"
Cadet Prince Fushimi, on board the "Yagumo".
Cadet Prince Asaka, on board the "Asama".
Rear-Admiral Nakamura, Commander of the Training Squadron, on
board the flagship "Yagumo".
During their sojourn in Shanghai they will attend numerous
receptions given in their honour by local Japanese officials
and residents and also visit places of interest in Shanghai.
They will leave here for Japan at 5 a.m. December 22 by the
"Yagumo" and the "Asama".
Vice-Admiral Hyakutake, Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese
Third Fleet, arrived in Shanghai from South China on December
16. During his stay in Shanghai he exchanged formal calls with
various foreign and Chinese officials and paid his respects
to the princes now visiting Shanghai. The Vice-Admiral is
expected to leave Shanghai for Nanking on December 23.
A list of prominent Japanese resident in Shanghai is
attached herewith.

D. S. Umemoto.
D. S.

D. C. Special Branch.
(批：DEC. 21 1934)

日期：1934年12月21日。

主题（全称） 日本要员在上海的行踪

由 D. S. Umemoto 编制。由 J.B.Kn D.. 转呈。

下列要员于12月19日乘练习舰“八云”号（Yagumo）和“浅间”号（Asama）抵达上海，两舰停泊于杨树浦路纽约邮船公司码头（N.Y... Hon. Kew Mail Wharf, Yangtsze Road）：
“八云”号首席炮术长 邦亲王中佐（Lieutenant Commander Prince Kuni）
“八云”号学员 伏见宫亲王（Cadet Prince Fushimi）
“浅间”号学员 朝香宫亲王（Cadet Prince Asaka）
练习舰队司令、旗舰“八云”号指挥官 中村少将（Rear-Admiral Nakamura）

他们在上海逗留期间，将出席当地日本官员和居民为他们举行的多次招待会，并参观上海的名胜古迹。他们将于12月22日凌晨5时乘“八云”号和“浅间”号离开此处前往日本。

日本第三舰队司令百武中将（Vice-Admiral Hyakutake）于12月16日从华南抵达上海。他在上海逗留期间，与各国及中国官员进行了正式互访，并向目前访问上海的各位亲王致意。预计该中将将于12月23日离开上海前往南京。
随函附上在上海的日本知名人士名单。

D. S. Umemoto.
D. S.

副警务总监，特务科。
（批注：1934年12月21日）

Subject (in full) Additional Japanese Officers Required by Section 2 of Special Branch.

Made by ana Forwarded by J.S.Ken D.I.

The marked increase in the work of this office in regard to matters appertaining to Japanese affairs necessitates the assigning of additional Japanese officers to the Special Branch.

D.S. Umemoto will be proceeding on long leave at the beginning of 1936, and in view of the fact that Superintendent Nakagawa - formerly attached to Crime Branch Headquarters - is no longer available due to his having been transferred to "C" Division, the training and/or transfer of one or more Japanese officers from either the Crime Branch or the Uniform Branch to the Special Branch has now become a matter of urgent necessity. Suitable candidates, who in addition to possessing a flair for this important phase of work, must hold the maximum bonus for the English language and be capable of translating from Japanese into English and vice-versa. In this connection J.D.C. 128 Kamashita (Central) is reported to be one of the few officers possessing these qualifications. It is therefore recommended that his transfer to the Special Branch be effected in order that he may be taken in hand by D.S. Umemoto, and given a thorough knowledge in regard to the duties performed by that officer.

J.S.Ken
D. I.

Mad
14/12

主题（全称） 特务科第二股需增派日本籍警员。

由 [签名不清] 编制，由 J.S.Ken 督察长转呈。

本办公室在处理涉及日本事务方面的工作量显著增加，因此有必要向特务科增派额外的日本籍警员。

D.S. Umemoto 将于1936年初开始长期休假，鉴于原隶属于刑事部总部的中川警司（Superintendent Nakagawa）已调往“C”分区，不再可用，从刑事部或制服部培训及/或调派一名或多名日本籍警员至特务科已成为当务之急。合适的人选除了必须具备胜任这一重要工作阶段的天赋外，还必须拥有英语最高等级津贴，并能够进行日英互译。在这方面，据悉 J.D.C. 128 山下（中央巡捕房）是少数具备这些资格的警员之一。因此，建议将其调往特务科，以便由 D.S. Umemoto 负责带教，使其全面了解该职位的职责。

J.S.Ken

Please instruct D.S. Umemoto to compile a
list of the names and addresses of all Japanese
officials in Shanghai of the grade of Consul-General
or higher and to report in advance any movements they
plan to make which is likely unduly to expose them
to attack. Reports should also be submitted when they
change addresses. Information should also be submitted
early of expected arrival of officials with particulars
of the programmes they intend to observe while in
Shanghai.

Please let me have a few names of Japanese in
uniform or detective work who would be suitable to act
in the place of D.S. Umemoto while he is on leave.
Is the man who was on the Special Branch before available?
It is best to have D.S. Umemoto's successor transferred
to the Special Branch as soon as possible so that he can
become fully acquainted with the work before D.S. Umemoto
goes on leave.

JDR 2/12

（签名）
D. C. (Sp.Br.)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

November 28, 1934

Commissioner of Police,

Sir,

Colonel Tan Bo Sheo, Chief of the Supervision
and Inspection Department of the Bureau of Public Safety
(Telephone 13749), called at the office of the Deputy
Commissioner (Special Branch) on the forenoon of
November 28, and reported that the Authorities of both
the Northern (Nanking) and Southern Governments had
received information, which is considered reliable, that
the Communist Parties of China, Japan and Korea have
decided in collusion with ex-officers of the 19th Route
Army, one of whom is named Chu, to organize a group in
Shanghai to assassinate important leaders of the Kuomintang
and important Japanese personages, including H.I.J.M's
Minister, with a view to embarrassing the Kuomintang and
causing a serious breach between China and Japan. It is
thought that the plotters may sometimes use the Burlington
Hotel which is the property of General Chen Ming Hsu,
who formerly commanded the 19th Route Army and caused
trouble in Fokien about a year ago.

Col. Tan feels that the following measures would
meet the danger which is threatened:-

(1) That close co-operation and exchange
of helpful information be maintained between the
Special Branch of the Municipal Police and his
department of the Public Safety Bureau.

(2) That special efforts be made to obtain

1934年11月28日

警务总监，

先生，

公安局督察处处长谭伯昭上校（Colonel Tan Bo Sheo，电话13749）于11月28日上午拜访了特务科副警务总监办公室，并报告称，北方（南京）和南方政府当局均收到被认为可靠的情报，称中国、日本和朝鲜的共产党已与第十九路军的前军官（其中一人姓朱）勾结，决定在上海组织一个团体，刺杀国民党重要领袖和包括日本驻华公使在内的日本重要人物，旨在使国民党陷入困境，并造成中日之间的严重破裂。据信，策划者有时会利用陈铭枢将军拥有的礼查饭店（Burlington Hotel），陈铭枢曾任第十九路军指挥官，约一年前在福建制造了事端。

谭上校认为，以下措施可应对所面临的危险：

(1) 市警察局特务科与其公安局部门之间保持密切合作并交换有益信息。

(2) 特别努力获取

(4) That wharves and railway stations be
